executive_summary: In highlight coverage, our privacy blockchain adoption research and stablecoin macroeconomic forecasts ($1.5 quadrillion by 2035) drove thought leadership placements across CoinMarketCap, Bloomberg, and Bitcoin World, positioning our monitoring capabilities as essential to institutional crypto growth. In crypto news, EU sanctions enforcement against Russian crypto platforms (HTX included in Reuters/Crowdfund Insider reporting) dominated headlines, North Korea's Bitcoin theft for nuclear weapons funding surfaced via Bitget, and Africa's $205bn crypto inflows (tech.africa) underscored emerging market momentum—all domains where our illicit finance and sanctions detection expertise is operationalized. In competitor news, Elliptic published stablecoin compliance and A7A5 ruble sanctions case studies across multiple outlets; Arkham Intelligence expanded multi-chain explorer positioning on Robinhood chain; Merkle Science pitched privacy-compliant blockchain monitoring to Crypto Briefing.
